description: Upgrade one canonical job instruction page from content schema v1 to v2 (details/callout/youtube/audio/attachment blocks). Two-step quiesce workflow: action "request" opens a PENDING upgrade and freezes new write-token issuance; wait until the returned quiesceReadyAt passes, then action "complete" performs the cutover. "status" reports the current state without changing anything. Every action is convergent and idempotent — repeats are safe and no idempotencyKey is needed. An already-v2 page reports COMPLETED with alreadyUpgraded=true.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_schema_upgrade
